reading.title: Talking About a Family Photo
reading.text: Nadia shows her colleague a family photo. Her mother and father stand beside each other; she calls them her parents, or mom and dad informally. Her brother holds his baby daughter and her sister sits beside him. Nadia calls her sister “my big sister” because she is the oldest child. Their little brother is also in the photo. A cousin and his twin are nearby. Nadia explains which relatives are her siblings.
reading.imageBrief: An adult holding a family-photo album at a table. Generic family members may appear in the photo, but do not infer biological relationships, gender identity or ages from appearance. The passage supplies relationships.

reading.title: Planning a Family Weekend
reading.text: Maya plans a holiday gathering with relatives. The youngest child chooses a game night, while the middle child prefers a movie night. An only child from another household joins the visit. Maya’s stepmother and stepfather organise a family dinner and a short road trip. Cooking together starts the weekend; a bedtime story ends the first evening. Before the family photo, Maya finishes her morning routine and offers homework help to a visiting relative.

reading.title: Supporting Each Other
reading.text: Nadia trusts her brother with an important decision. He listens carefully and offers support. Their parents show care by asking what she needs. Nadia values their guidance, but makes the final choice herself. At dinner, they share a story from their heritage. Affection and love strengthen their bond. Fair discipline sets household rules, while protection means helping keep one another safe.
reading.imageBrief: Adult relatives listening to one another around a dinner table. Warm ordinary interaction without using appearance to prove love, trust, heritage or a biological family bond.
